# OCR acceptance fixtures

`scan.pdf` contains rasterized pages 1–3 of Machado de Assis's public-domain
O Alienista. `mixed.pdf` combines the native first page and rasterized second
page. Generated by `studio/smoke_ocr.py` with grayscale and mild blur.

Source: https://files.livrosdominiopublico.com.br/livros/pt/machado-de-assis/o-alienista.pdf

These fixtures exercise real OCR, Portuguese accents, mixed PDF handling and
page checkpoints. They are not representative of every scanner or document.
